references.text: The Chronicler confirms the identity of the wife and the outcome of the marriage mentioned in Genesis 38:2.
Same narrative context; shows how Judah's earlier choice (to take a Canaanite woman) led to a situation where he himself was deceived.
Prophetic condemnation of the same marriage pattern (Judah + foreign woman) as a picture of spiritual unfaithfulness.
Direct narrative continuation; the consequence of Judah's family relationships (begun in v. 2) unfolds here.
Continues the story of the same person (Shua's daughter) who was mentioned in the source verse.
